propositions: autodeploy.sh recreates the review-bot container whenever main advances and bot source changes, without draining in-flight reviews, interrupting running code reviews mid-task
killing a review mid-execution leaves no VOTER_ERROR signal, so the gate live-locks with all health checks reporting green while no LLM-Review votes are cast
the reconciler retry path awaits review_and_vote inline outside the shutdown queue, causing it to be cancelled within ~10s while webhook-queued reviews are protected by up to 1320s grace period
landing bursts with deploy gaps shorter than ~10min review time guarantee the reconciler's retry is killed before it can vote, creating convergence-blocking live-lock
autodeploy.sh now defers deploy cycles if in_flight reviews are signaled via /health endpoint, with 1800s bound keyed to deferral episode not target SHA, and logs deferral events for observability
new AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT alarm watches for signal-unavailable or bound-exceeded cases to close the blind spot where a fully live-locked gate left health signals green
